title: Ada in front of the lens.
label: ● HISTORICAL PHOTOGRAPH
alt: Historical daguerreotype of Ada Lovelace by Antoine Claudet, showing her in a dark dress within a gold oval frame.
caption: A real photographic portrait, not a painting. No laptop and no imaginary holiday itinerary.
credit: Antoine Claudet. Daguerreotype dated 1843 or 1850 in the source file's title and description. Reproduction: Wikimedia Commons, courtesy of Geoffrey Bond. Public domain.

title: The portrait you recognise.
label: ● HISTORICAL PAINTING
alt: Period watercolour portrait of Ada Lovelace in a light dress with dark lace, attributed to A. E. Chalon.
caption: Ada from the homepage, this time without our stickers. This is a reproduction of a watercolour, not a photograph of Ada.
credit: Watercolour portrait from around 1840, attributed to Alfred Edward Chalon. Science Museum; reproduction from Wikimedia Commons. Public domain.

title: A portrait in grand style.
label: ● HISTORICAL PAINTING
alt: Oil painting of Ada Lovelace by Margaret Sarah Carpenter, 1836, showing Ada standing in a white dress with a red sash.
caption: A period portrait in full ceremonial splendour. Dress code: algorithmic elegance.
credit: Margaret Sarah Carpenter, 1836, oil on canvas. Government Art Collection; reproduction from Wikimedia Commons. Public domain.
